The label of a kids' bubble bath containing a foaming surfactant must include the caution: "Use only as directed. Excessive use or prolonged exposure may cause irritation to skin and urinary tract. Discontinue use if rash, redness, or itching occurs. Consult your physician if irritation persists. Keep out of reach of children." Additionally, for products intended for use by children, the phrase “except under adult supervision” may be added at the end of that caution. These requirements apply except for products labeled as intended for use exclusively by adults [2], and the addition of "except under adult supervision" is only permitted when the product is intended for use by children [4].

The label must bear adequate directions for safe use and the following caution:  
Caution—Use only as directed. Keep out of reach of children [3].  

For a kids' bubble bath intended for use by children, the phrase “except under adult supervision” may be added at the end of the caution required in paragraph (b) [4].
